import unittest

from relnotes import render_release


class EdgeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_multiline_comment_hiding_heading(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01\n\na\n<!--\n## [bogus]\n-->\nb\n"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)\n\na\nb\n")

    def test_trailing_whitespace_and_blank_runs(self):
        text = "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-01\n\n\n- x   <!-- c -->\n  \n\n\n- y\n\n\n"
        self.assertEqual(render_release(text, "1.0.0"), "# 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)\n\n- x\n\n- y\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
